name: Adhari
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Mortazavi, Manuchehr. 1354 Sh./1975. "Āṯār o asnād-e marbūṭ be zabān-e dīrīn-e Āḏarbāyjān" (lecture, 6th Congress of Iranian Studies, Tabriz), Našrīya-ye Dāneškada-ye Adabīyāt o ʿOlūm-e Ensānī-ye Tabrīz, 35 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No occurrence of تکیه (stress); surveys historical testimonies, the surviving texts, and the Tati 'language islands' (Harzand, Dizmar, Khalkhal).

sources.citation: Henning, W. B. 1954. "The Ancient Language of Azerbaijan." Transactions of the Philological Society 53: 157-177 (DOI 10.1111/j.1467-968x.1954.tb00282.x); read in the reprint, Selected Papers II (Acta Iranica 15), Leiden/Tehran 1977, 457-477, via archive.org scanned text of item w.-b.-henning-selected-papers.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-; also held in print at Harvard (a Harvard library, call number PERIODICALS P11.P6; Widener Library, call number Philol 56; Widener Library (offsite storage), call number Philol 56; Widener Library, call number Philol 57)
sources.harvard_location: a Harvard library, call number PERIODICALS P11 .P6; Widener Library, call number Philol 56; Widener Library (offsite storage), call number Philol 56; Widener Library, call number Philol 57
sources.note: No occurrence of 'stress', 'accent' or 'tone' anywhere in the scanned text of the paper (scanned has some gaps). Content is historical phonology (t > r isogloss), Harzani and Takestani verb/noun morphology, and the textual remains; no prosody.

sources.citation: Kasravi, Ahmad. 1304 Sh./1925 (typed later re-edition). Āḏarī yā zabān-e bāstān-e Āḏarbāyjān. Tehran.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No occurrence of تکیه / آکسان / استرس (stress, accent) in the full scanned text; the book is a historical-philological treatment of the testimonia, the verse remains and etymologies.

sources.citation: Yarshater, Ehsan. 1988. "Azerbaijan vii. The Iranian Language of Azerbaijan." Encyclopaedia Iranica III/3: 238-245 (online edition, last updated 2016).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Adhari stress. 'Linguistic features' section treats only segmental history (OIr. intervocalic t > r, x > h, etc.), morphology and vocabulary of the Shaikh Safi dobaytis and the Istanbul qasidas. The only stress word in the article concerns Northern Talyshi ('characterized by the dropping or greatly reducing of unstressed syllables'), not Adhari.
Nothing on stress; bibliography lists Yarshater 1988, Henning 1954, Kasravi 1925, Windfuhr 2009, Paul 1998 — no phonological study of Adhari.
